critical_code_review_comments: DiscoveryCenter.jsx: toggle() uses s.slice(-1) so selection is capped at 2 (last + new). Works but subtle — a small comment would help future readers.

Snapshot label default uses only date (`Snapshot ${date}`), so multiple snapshots taken same day share identical display labels — makes UX ambiguous when comparing (see screenshot: 'Snapshot 28.07.2026 → Snapshot 28.07.2026'). Consider adding time in default label.
